variations.reading_hi: Jab Saturn ki line kamzor ya adhuri ho, yeh sanket deta hai ki life mein kuch rukawatein aur mushkilein aa sakti hain. Yeh sthayi nahi hai — doosre hath ke nishaan agar majboot hon toh yeh prabhav kam ho sakta hai. Is par kaam kiya ja sakta hai apni mehnat aur awareness se. Jab fate line kaafi jagah se kata hua ya tuta hua dikhta hai — jise purane texts mein Via Combusta kaha jaata hai — yeh sanket deta hai ki jeevan mein kuch rukawatein ya interruptions aa sakti hain. Yeh sthayi nahi hai, aur sahi koshish se in chunautiyon se paar paaya ja sakta hai. Apni planning aur consistency par dhyaan dein.
